bodies.name: Village of Pelham
bodies.label: Village Government
bodies.description: The primary local government for residents of "Pelham Heights" and former North Pelham. The Board of Trustees sets policy, manages the budget, and runs most everyday services — police, fire, garbage, water, and roads.

meeting_schedule.participation: Sign up for public comment at the meeting; agendas posted online

bodies.public_comment_process: Residents typically sign in at the door before the meeting starts.
bodies.board_name: Village of Pelham Board of Trustees
bodies.layer_controls: Police, fire, refuse, water, roads and the building department — for Village of Pelham residents only.

bodies.name: Village of Pelham Manor
bodies.label: Village Government
bodies.description: The second of Pelham's two villages, covering the Manor neighborhood. Has its own elected Mayor and Board of Trustees, runs its own police and fire departments, and manages village-level services independently.

meeting_schedule.participation: Public comment period at each meeting

bodies.public_comment_process: Public comment is often called from the floor — residents simply stand or raise their hand when the chair invites public comment.
bodies.board_name: Village of Pelham Manor Board of Trustees
bodies.layer_controls: Its own police, fire and public works departments — for Pelham Manor residents only.

bodies.name: Town of Pelham
bodies.label: Town Government
bodies.description: The Town umbrella covers both villages. Rather than duplicating services, it handles shared functions that make sense to consolidate: municipal courts, tax assessment & collection, recreation programs, the public library, and ambulance service.

meeting_schedule.participation: Public hearing notices posted; residents may comment during hearings

bodies.public_comment_process: Public comment is often called from the floor — residents simply stand or raise their hand when the chair invites public comment.
bodies.layer_controls: Municipal courts, tax assessment and collection, recreation programmes, the public library, and the ambulance service shared by both villages.

bodies.name: Pelham Union Free School District
bodies.label: School District
bodies.description: An elected Board of Education governs K–12 education across four elementary schools, one middle school, and Pelham Memorial High School. The school district has its own budget voted on separately by residents each May.

meeting_schedule.participation: Public comment period; annual budget vote each May

bodies.public_comment_process: A floor-based process similar to the Town Board — residents stand or raise their hand when the chair invites public comment.
bodies.layer_controls: K–12 education across four elementary schools, the middle school and Pelham Memorial High School.

bodies.name: Westchester County
bodies.label: County Government
bodies.description: County government provides regional services including the county police, health department, parks, sewer districts, and social services. Westchester is also the entity that establishes equalization rates used in property tax assessments.
bodies.layer_controls: Health department, parks, sewer districts, social services, county police — and the equalization rates used in property assessments.

extra_schedule_rows.name: School District Budget Vote
extra_schedule_rows.location: Pelham Middle School Gymnasium (7 am – 9 pm)
extra_schedule_rows.participation: Any registered voter in the district may vote; no appointment needed
